entities.summary: Igor Shulepov is a Russian volleyball player born in Yekaterinburg who competed in the 1996 Summer Olympics and in the 2000 Summer Olympics. In 1996 he was part of the Russian team which finished fourth in the Olympic tournament. He played all eight matches. Four years later he won the silver medal with the Russian team in the 2000 Olympic tournament.
